question: Who among the following Indian cricketers has won the ICC Emerging Women's cricketer award for the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Renuka Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Renuka Singh:-**

 
 
• She is the Indian cricketer who has won the ICC Emerging Women's cricketer award for the year 2022.
 
• She is a left-arm spinner and has represented the Indian women's cricket team in the past. 
 
 
 
• **ICC Emerging Women's cricketer award:-**
 
 
• The ICC Emerging Women's cricketer award is given to the best young female player who has performed well in international cricket during the given period.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smriti Mandhana:-**

 
 
• She is a left-handed opening batter who has been a consistent performer for the Indian women's cricket team in recent years. She has won several awards including the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year in 2018. 
 
 
 
• **Harmanpreet Kaur:-**
 
 
• She is an all-rounder who is known for her aggressive batting and effective off-spin bowling. She is also the captain of the Indian women's T20 team.
 
 
 
• **Jhulan Goswami:-**
 
 
• She is a right-arm medium-fast bowler who is the leading wicket-taker in women's ODI cricket. She has also won several awards including the Arjuna Award and the Padma Shri.
